title: [PM seat] domain:ui — 🟢 os-steve · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 1**, the lane's first post on this board: objectui became this repository's `ui/` workspace (#25825), and the lane's former post lived on the objectui board, which this seat cannot reach. No `domain:ui` post existed in the `pm:seat` index here (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (the Claude Code project "objectstack", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发") · `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, seated on the maintainer's word in that project (「你开始负责 ui 车道，并发10」, 2026-10-26T06:20Z). Mutex readings at seating: no prior `domain:ui` post, no open `pm:dispatched` card in the lane, no assignee on any open lane card.
- **Second seat:** `domain:ui` seat 2 = #25995 (maintainer's word, 2026-10-26). The split is by the fix's landing package. Seat 2 holds plugin-list / grid / detail / form / view / kanban / calendar / gantt / map / timeline / tree / charts / dashboard / report and `fields`. After the 09:18Z rebalance it also holds the auth pages (login / register / invitation), the app-shell Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 holds everything else: i18n packs, `components` (form.tsx), Studio / designer, AI chat and build, approvals, tech-debt. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (the ui-merge `pm:epic` subtree under #25677 is editing them; maintainer's word in the project). **Manifest records are per package** since #26120 (#26051) merged at 13:49Z, and the single token is retired. A PR enqueues once every earlier PR that shares a registry package with it (non-test `src/` under `ui/packages/PKG`) has MERGED. A PR that changes `sdui.manifest.json` itself re-records every package and stays globally serial. Order by package (both seats): plugin-detail #25998 → #26053 → #26060 → #26055; i18n #26045 → #26040 → #26044 → #26048 → #26055 → #25921; plugin-grid #26030 → #26033 → #26050; plugin-form #26042 → #26033; fields: seat 2 orders #26050 / #26062. Every open PR first merges `origin/main` once (taking main's `record.json`) and regenerates. Other lanes: only a PR on the same package needs to wait. PRs that change no registry package (app-shell, plugin-chatbot, apps/console) queue freely after merging the latest `origin/main` and building. `ObjectView.tsx`: #25992 slice 1 in flight, so no other seat 1 card edits it. Chat hydration: #25908 (blocked on cloud#3292) follows #25887 (landed).
- **In flight (2026-10-26T13:30Z):** #25871 · #25874 · #25877 · #25888 · #25897 (PRs waiting on the token) · #25925 (#26127 in the merge queue, off-record) · #25992 slice 1 · #25915 slice 1 (app-shell, off-record) · #25921, one card thread each; readings on the cards. Free slot left empty on purpose: the queued seat 1 candidates wait on a file (#25872 behind #26011 on `FlowRunner.tsx`, #25934 behind #26053 on the record-page lock) or on a maintainer or cloud answer (#26059, #25943). Landed today: #25858 · #25887 · #25890 · #25892 · #25894 · #25898 · #25899 · #25900 · #25901 · #25938 · #25999; #25916 closed (both tasks done). Handed to seat 2: #25886 (server child #26020). Released to triage: #25908 (split to cloud), #25913 (re-scoped to devx). Filed: #26131 (console chunk membership red on `main`).
- **Standing constraints (maintainer, project chat):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR is opened on the objectui repository.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments + `head:claude/` PRs, read by `assignee:os-steve`.
- **Wall:** none.
